sourceHints.lmp: If you know the date of your last period, this is the simplest option. The estimate range is usually about ±5 days.
sourceHints.ultrasound: Based on an ultrasound result; early scans usually give a narrower estimate range.
sourceHints.manual: If your doctor told you how many weeks you are. The estimate range depends on how precise that was.
